messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Team Ember now does pairing on every production change. [decision; valid 2025-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-11-2]
- Team Dune owns the job scheduler as of 2025-04-04. [valid 2025-04-04 to now; recorded by handover/2025-04-04-scheduler]
    earlier: Ember owns the job scheduler. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-04-04; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- Boreal owns the indexer as of 2026-04-22, after Team Dune handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-04-22 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-22-search-indexer]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the indexer as of 2025-11-18, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-15 to 2026-04-22; recorded by handover/2025-12-15-search-indexer-correction]
    earlier: Ember owns the indexer as of 2025-11-18, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-11-18 to 2025-12-15; recorded by handover/2025-11-18-search-indexer]
    earlier: Boreal still owns the indexer as of 2025-09-15. [valid 2025-09-15 to 2025-11-18; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-15-2]
- Diego held the Cinder on-call phone from 2025-11-25 until 2025-12-15, after which Yuki took it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-15 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-12-15]
    earlier: Diego took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-11-25, with Yuki off rotation. [decision; valid 2025-11-25 to 2025-12-15; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-25]
    earlier: Yuki took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-10-02, with Diego off rotation. [decision; valid 2025-10-02 to 2025-11-25; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-10-02]
    earlier: Diego took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-08-29. [decision; valid 2025-08-29 to 2025-10-02; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-29]
    earlier: Yuki took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-07-22. [decision; valid 2025-07-22 to 2025-08-29; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-22]
- Team Dune owns image-resizer as of 2026-01-20, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-01-20 to now; recorded by handover/2026-01-20-image-resizer]
    earlier: Boreal owns image-resizer as of 2025-11-19, after Cinder handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-11-19 to 2026-01-20; recorded by handover/2025-11-19-image-resizer]
    earlier: Cinder owns image-resizer as of 2025-06-25. [decision; valid 2025-06-25 to 2025-11-19; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-image-resizer]
    earlier: Team Dune owns image-resizer. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- The reports pipeline went to Boreal as of 2025-06-25, not Ember; Team Ember never owned it, and Team Dune no longer owns it. [decision; valid 2025-07-03 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-03-reporting-correction]
    earlier: Team Ember owns the reports pipeline as of 2025-06-25, and Team Dune no longer owns it. [decision; valid 2025-06-25 to 2025-07-03; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-reporting]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the reporting service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- Cinder owns the notifier as of 2025-11-19; Boreal owned it until that date. [decision; valid 2025-11-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-19-notifier]
    earlier: Boreal owns notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-11-19; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09]
- Ledger is not Team Dune's service, so Team Dune flagged the latency issue instead of fixing it. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-08]
- Ledger is not Team Atlas's service, so Team Atlas flagged the disk usage jump instead of fixing it. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16-2]
- Team Atlas saw on 2026-04-16 that Ledger's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16-2]
- Team Dune observed on 2025-12-08 that Ledger's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-08]
- The reporting service was moved off direct Ledger queries because nightly Ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [valid 2025-09-19 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-19]
- The reports pipeline depends on Ledger for the nightly balance export, so if Ledger is down the reports pipeline is down. [valid 2025-02-06 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-02-06]
- Ledger depends on the authentication gateway for service tokens. [valid 2025-03-14 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-14]
- Ledger is pinned to Postgres 14 as of 2025-05-30. [constraint; valid 2025-05-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-05-30]
- Billing-api depends on Ledger to work. [constraint; valid 2026-03-05 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-05]
- Cinder took over Ledger from Boreal on 2026-04-29. [decision; valid 2026-04-29 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-29-ledger]

Question: Which team owns the ledger now?

message.reasoning: The question asks which team owns Ledger now. Today is 2026-06-30. The last entry: "Cinder took over Ledger from Boreal on 2026-04-29. [decision; valid 2026-04-29 to now]". So answer: Cinder.
